stories.title: Projecting next year's QB market: Most likely scenarios and long-shot possibilities for 16 NFL teams
stories.summary: We picked out teams with some level of QB1 questions for 2027 and projected two potential outcomes for each -- one likely and one not so likely.

stories.title: Sankey: Pros returning to school 'fuels disruption'
stories.summary: SEC commissioner Greg Sankey asked a judge to uphold NCAA rules that prevent athletes from returning to play in college.

stories.title: Lakers minority owner not selling his 4% stake
stories.summary: One of the Lakers' minority owners, Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong, has no plans to sell his 4% stake in the team, his attorney told ESPN.

stories.title: Cowboys, Saints fined $500K for practice brawls
stories.summary: The NFL has fined the Cowboys and Saints $500,000 each after multiple fights broke out between the two teams during Tuesday's joint practice.

stories.title: Ronaldinho, 46, arrives to restart career in Italy
stories.summary: Brazil great Ronaldinho has landed in Ravenna, a city more famous for its nearby beaches than its soccer team.
